name: City of Edinburgh
title: Edinburgh —
tagline: A castle on a volcanic rock, the Royal Mile and the world's biggest arts festival.
summary: Edinburgh has been Scotland's capital for centuries and its Old and New Towns are a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The Castle, the Royal Mile and Holyrood Palace sit along a ridge that runs down from an extinct volcano.
Every August the city hosts the Edinburgh Festival Fringe and the Military Tattoo, and Hogmanay on 31 December draws visitors from around the world. The Scottish Parliament sits at Holyrood.

sport.intro: Edinburgh has two big football clubs, Hearts and Hibs, and Scotland's national rugby team plays at Murrayfield.

community.intro: Edinburgh people have gone abroad for generations and Burns suppers, St Andrew's Day dinners and Hogmanay parties are held by Scots societies worldwide.

ancestry: Searching for your family's roots? ScotlandsPeople, the Scottish Government's genealogy service, holds statutory registers of births, marriages and deaths, census returns and Old Parish Registers.
